title: Chat assistant
intro: Connect your messaging account to ask about your parcels from your phone.
howItWorks: Generating a link creates a one-time code that connects your Telegram account to this platform account, so the assistant knows who is asking. The code works only once and expires after a few minutes — if it stops working, just generate a new one.
qrAlt: QR code for the Telegram linking link
fallbackInstruction: No app installed? Message the bot directly: send /start followed by this code.
error: The operation could not be completed.

llm.title: Assistant: AI provider
llm.intro: The assistant uses your organisation's own AI provider and key. Your organisation pays the provider directly for what the assistant uses.
llm.keyNote: The key is stored encrypted and is never shown again; only its last four characters are displayed.
llm.unavailable: Saving a provider is not available on this platform right now.
llm.noneAllowed: No AI provider is enabled on this platform yet.
llm.notConfigured: No provider is set up: until you add one, the assistant will answer that it is not configured.
llm.keyRequired: Enter the key for this provider.
llm.keyKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
llm.budget: Maximum tokens per answer (optional, up to {{ceiling}})

errors.byok_unavailable: Saving a provider is not available on this platform right now.
errors.endpoint_not_allowed: This provider or address is not enabled on this platform.
errors.key_required: A key is required when you add a provider or change its provider or address.
errors.budget_above_ceiling: The token limit is above the maximum allowed.
errors.invalid_model: The model name is not valid.
